title: AgentMonopoly: Behavioral Patterns and Persona Control in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.29330v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How do LLM agents' strategies differ, and how much can instructions to adopt a persona change their behavior over a game? We study these questions with AgentMonopoly, an environment where agents communicate, buy and trade properties, and make decisions that affect later turns. We compare models from four families, each at two sizes, in games with identical models, different sizes of the same family, or different families. We also assign one agent a persona, a description of how it should behave, intended to change a tendency observed in games without that persona. The tested models differ in how often they trade, waive rent, and manage cash and properties. Larger models do not consistently win more games. Persona instructions change the words agents use and some of their actions, but the changes do not always match the role across all decisions. translated_title: AgentMonopoly：LLM智能体的行为模式与人格控制
translated_abstract: LLM智能体的策略有何差异？通过指令让智能体采用某种人格设定，能在多大程度上改变其在游戏中的行为？我们通过AgentMonopoly来研究这些问题——这是一个智能体可以进行沟通、购买和交易地产，并做出影响后续回合决策的环境。我们比较了来自四个模型家族（每个家族两种规模）的模型，对局形式包括相同模型之间、同一家族不同规模之间以及不同家族之间。我们还会给某个智能体分配一种人格描述，旨在改变在没有人格设定的对局中观察到的某种行为倾向。测试的模型在交易频率、免除租金以及管理现金和资产方面表现出差异。更大的模型并不总是赢得更多对局。人格指令会改变智能体使用的语言及其部分行为，但这些变化并不总能在所有决策中与所设定的角色保持一致。这些结果表明，为什么应当通过行为和结果（而不仅仅是语言）来评估人格遵循能力。
tldr: 该论文提出了AgentMonopoly环境，通过类大富翁游戏对局研究不同家族和规模的LLM智能体的行为差异，发现各模型在交易、租金管理和资产策略上表现各异，更大模型并不必然获胜，而人格指令虽能改变智能体的语言和部分行为，却无法在所有决策中稳定地与角色设定保持一致。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgentMonopoly, an environment where LLM agents of different families and sizes play a Monopoly-like game, revealing that models differ in trading, rent waiving, and cash/property management strategies, larger models do not consistently win, and persona instructions change agents' language and some actions but do not reliably align behavior with the assigned role across all decisions.
